subject: VentureX network assimilation: private endpoints, appliance plan & preflight
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@venturex.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@venturex.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood private deployment — initial network info and ask

Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks for a productive demo last week. VentureX is ready to start the private deployment path — we want the on-prem appliance in our EU region behind our firewall and a set of private endpoints for API traffic. Before we lock dates, two asks from our side: 1) an initial high-level network diagram of what Redwood will require (IP ranges, peering, DNS, egress rules), and 2) a draft SOW so procurement can begin a parallel review.

I've attached a very rough internal network diagram to show the VLANs and where we'd prefer the appliance to live. We're targeting mid-June for a staged cutover but flexible if Redwood needs more runway.

Can we kick off a short technical preflight this week? Alex (cc'd) will be our networking lead and will own the inventory side.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Liu
Head of Infrastructure, VentureX Systems
attachments: venturex_network_diagram_v2.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@venturex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial network info and ask

Ethan — thanks, this is great context and the diagram is helpful.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical preflight call (45m) to validate IPs, peering, routing, and certificates
- Share Redwood preflight checklist (attached) and a first-pass SOW (draft) by EOD Monday
- Assign owners on both sides for inventory items (hostnames, CIDR blocks, KMS/HSM details)

I can run the preflight with Marissa and Ben on our side. Ben will take point for appliance install + on-prem packaging questions; Marissa will own private endpoint and VPC peering configuration.

Please confirm availability for these slots (all times CEST):
- Thu 2026-05-20 09:00–09:45
- Thu 2026-05-20 15:00–15:45
- Fri 2026-05-21 10:00–10:45

Attaching: redwood_private_preflight_checklist.xlsx and sow-draft-venturex-v1.docx (SOW is a skeleton we can iterate).

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Customer Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_private_preflight_checklist.xlsx; sow-draft-venturex-v1.docx
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T13:20:00Z
Subject: Internal: VentureX preflight — roles and quick checklist

Marissa / Ben — quick internal note after Ethan's request. Summary and owners:
- Marissa: lead on VPC peering, private endpoint az mapping, DNS split-horizon guidance. Prep: review VentureX diagram and confirm if there are existing NAT gateways or a transit VPC.
- Ben: appliance packaging/ops. Prep: confirm on-prem package requirements (rack density, NICs, OS image, HSM/KMS connectivity options).
- Chloe: run the preflight call and draft SOW updates based on their procurement notes.

Prep items for call (Chloe will send invite after they confirm a slot):
- Review venturex_network_diagram_v2.pdf and annotate expected CIDR conflicts
- Confirm our SOW template variables and pricing placeholders
- Prepare checklist section that maps to their security questionnaire (SOC 2 items) — keep it high level for now

Ben — can you run a quick check of our appliance image compatibility with their VLAN segmentation by Monday EOD?
Marissa — can you draft the VPC peering options (peer vs. Private Endpoint vs. Transit) and pros/cons per EU region constraints?

Thanks,
Chloe
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@venturex.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@venturex.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, VentureX NOC <noc@venturex.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial network info and ask

Chloe / team,

Thanks — Thu 2026-05-20 15:00–15:45 CEST works best for us. We've also attached a cleaned-export of our network diagram and a short procurement note that lists the purchasing PO contact and typical SOW review windows.

Two clarifications for the preflight:
1) We plan to use a dedicated transit VPC for vendor appliances rather than peering directly into our prod VPCs. If Redwood can support that, it simplifies our firewall rules.
2) Our security team will want a brief write-up on data-at-rest encryption and key management — we can take the high level during the call but will request SOC2 evidence later in procurement.

I'll attach: venturex_network_diagram_v2.pdf (clean) and venturex_procurement_notes.pdf

See you Thu at 15:00 CEST.

—Alex
Network Engineering Lead, VentureX
attachments: venturex_network_diagram_v2.pdf; venturex_procurement_notes.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@venturex.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@venturex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — technical preflight confirmed (Thu 15:00 CEST)

Perfect — confirmed for Thu 2026-05-20 15:00–15:45 CEST (invitation sent). High-level agenda:
1) Quick intros + success criteria (5m)
2) Transit VPC topology and private endpoint options (15m)
3) Appliance install requirements & packaging questions (10m)
4) KMS/HSM and SOC2 evidence path (10m)
5) Action items and draft SOW next steps (5m)

Immediate action items before the call:
- VentureX: share the PO cadence and any procurement constraints (Alex) — done, thanks.
- Redwood (Ben): confirm appliance NIC / storage / racking constraints in a one-pager — target Tue EOD.
- Redwood (Marissa): prepare two peering options for transit VPC vs private endpoint and one recommended path for EU production latency needs — target Tue EOD.
- Redwood (Chloe): update SOW draft with the transit VPC option noted and send version 1.1 to Ethan & procurement after the call.

Attaching the preflight checklist again for visibility. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Customer Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_private_preflight_checklist.xlsx
